budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrant W # 63-12 was presented for approval.
Town Manager reported estimated net savings from refunding the 2003 General Obligation Bond Issue, which reduces property taxes over the remaining 10 years.
budget_items.quote: the estimated net savings to the town will be $681,566.32.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Next 6-month residential supply rate of 5.85 cents per kWh, a 25% reduction over the existing rate.
budget_items.quote: the rate which residential customers will be paying under this program will be 5.85 cents per k w which is a 25% reduction over the existing rate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Opt-out farm customers receive the farm rate, which is 90% of Unitil's standard rate; the Town Manager asked that the farm rate be considered in the next bid.
budget_items.quote: which is 90% of unitil's standard rate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Personal property tax bills can be as small as $5 or less, with a recommended exemption threshold of $2500; a resident said $3,000 would be spread across all properties if small parcels were eliminated.
